body.x: Floome(www.floome.com), unveiled Floome, a universal smartphone accessory that provides users with accurate and reliable blood-alcohol readings, at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.Floome is a convenient device which measures the blood alcohol concentration (BAC) and sends the results directly to the smartphone. It works just by plugging it into any smartphones via a standarad audio jack and no battery is required. It notifies the BAC through the smartphone screen, and even suggests recommended recovery time.
